Az ÖSSZES hibát megkeresed a kódban Az elsőtől az utolsóig minden karaktert átnézel Csak a konkrét pontos hibákat mindet írod Listába  majd ha megtalaltad az osszes hibat teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód  egy kód mezőbe írjad a teljes kódot es legyen 100% osan hiba mentes!  es arra törekedj hogy mindenben a kód a lehető legfejlettebb legjobb teljesítményű leggyorsabb és mindenben a legjobb legyen! 


;;;; main.lisp — xAI Grok 4 Fast teljes példa CLISP + Replit
;;;;  NINCS OpenAI SDK, közvetlen xAI REST hívások
;;;;  Quicklisp bootstrap (első futás letölt)
;;;;  Drakma (HTTP), CLJSON (JSON)
;;;;  Demonstrált funkciók: chat, JSON mode, tool calling, vision (image_url), embeddings

;;;;  Quicklisp bootstrap (CLISP + Replit) 
(evalwhen (:compiletoplevel :loadtoplevel :execute)
  (when (not (findpackage :quicklisp))
    (let ((home (userhomedirpathname))
           (qlsetup (mergepathnames "quicklisp/setup.lisp" home)))
      (unless (probefile qlsetup)
        (let ((tmp (mergepathnames "quicklisp.lisp" home))
               (curl (or (ignoreerrors (ext:runprogram "which" '("curl") :output :string))
                         "")))
          (format t "~&[INFO] Quicklisp letöltés...~%")
          (ext:runprogram "curl"
                           (list "L" ""
                                 "o" (namestring tmp))
                           :output t)
          (load tmp)
          (funcall (intern "INSTALL" "QUICKLISP")
                   :path (namestring (mergepathnames "quicklisp/" home)))
          (funcall (intern "ADDTOINITFILE" "QUICKLISP"))))
      (load qlsetup))))

;;;;  Könyvtárak betöltése 
(ql:quickload '(:drakma :cljson :flexistreams) :silent t)

;;;;  Csomag 
(defpackage :xaidemo
  (:use :cl)
  (:export :main))
(inpackage :xaidemo)

;;;;  Segédek 
(defun getenv (name)
  +clisp (ext:getenv name)
  clisp (uiop:getenv name))

(defparameter xaiapikey (or (getenv "XAI_API_KEY") ""))
(defparameter xaibaseurl "")
;; Állítható modellek – ha a pontos név eltér, itt módosítsd:
(defparameter xaichatmodel "grok4fast")
(defparameter xaiembeddingmodel "grokembedding1")

(defun ensureapikey ()
  (when (or (null xaiapikey) (string= xaiapikey ""))
    (error "Hianyzik az XAI_API_KEY kornyezeti valtozo. A Replit Secretsben add hozza.")))

(defun jsonencode (obj)
  (cljson:encodejsontostring obj))

(defun jsondecode (str)
  ;; JSON objektum: hashtable, tömb: list
  (let ((cljson:jsonobjecttype 'hashtable)
        (cljson:jsonarraytype 'list))
    (cljson:decodejsonfromstring str)))

(defun httpjson (method path payload)
  "Egységes JSON kérés az xAI APIhoz."
  (ensureapikey)
  (let ((url (concatenate 'string xaibaseurl path))
         (body (and payload (jsonencode payload)))
         (headers (("Authorization" . ,(concatenate 'string "Bearer " xaiapikey))
                    ("ContentType"  . "application/json"))))
    (multiplevaluebind (respbody status respheaders)
        (drakma:httprequest url
                             :method method
                             :content body
                             :additionalheaders headers
                             :forcebinary nil)
      (when (or (null respbody) (not (<= 200 status 299)))
        (error "HTTP hiba ~A: ~A" status respbody))
      (jsondecode respbody))))

(defun pretty (x)
  (cljson:encodejsontostring x :escapeslash nil :indent t))

;;;;  xAI API wrapperek 

(defun xaichatcompletions (messages &key (model xaichatmodel) tools responseformat temperature)
  "POST /chat/completions"
  (let ((payload (let ((base (("model" . ,model)
                               ("messages" . ,messages))))
                   (when tools
                     (setf base (append base (("tools" . ,tools)))))
                   (when responseformat
                     (setf base (append base (("response_format" . ,responseformat)))))
                   (when temperature
                     (setf base (append base (("temperature" . ,temperature)))))
                   base)))
    (httpjson :post "/chat/completions" payload)))

(defun xaiembeddings (inputs &key (model xaiembeddingmodel))
  "POST /embeddings"
  (httpjson :post "/embeddings"
             (("model" . ,model)
               ("input" . ,(if (listp inputs) inputs (list inputs))))))

;;;;  Üzenet segédkészítők 

(defun msg (role content)
  ;; egyszerű szöveges üzenet
  (("role" . ,role) ("content" . ,content)))

(defun visioncontent (text imageurl)
  ;; vision: content tömb vegyes részekkel
  (("role" . "user")
    ("content" .
      ,(list
         (("type" . "text") ("text" . ,text))
         (("type" . "image_url") ("image_url" . (("url" . ,imageurl)))))))))

;;;;  Tool calling példa 

(defun makeweathertool ()
  (("type" . "function")
    ("function" .
      (("name" . "get_weather")
       ("description" . "Egyszeru idojaraskerdezo demo; varos/orszag alapjan ad vissza homersekletet (fiktiv).")
       ("parameters" .
         (("type" . "object")
          ("properties" .
            (("location" . (("type" . "string")
                            ("description" . "Varos vagy orszag neve.")))
             ("unit" . (("type" . "string")
                        ("enum" . ("C" "F"))
                        ("description" . "Homerseklet egysege.")))))
          ("required" . ("location"))))))))

(defun applytoollocally (name argsjson)
  "Lokális toolvégrehajtás. argsjson: JSON string."
  (let ((args (jsondecode argsjson))
         (get (lambda (k) (gethash k args)))
         (unit (or (funcall get "unit") "C")))
    (cond
      ((string= name "get_weather")
       (let ((loc (or (funcall get "location") "Ismeretlen"))
              ;; demo: fiktív adat
              (tempc 21.5)
              (val (if (string= unit "F")
                       (+ ( tempc 9/5) 32)
                       tempc)))
         (jsonencode (("location" . ,loc)
                        ("temperature" . ,(if (string= unit "F") "F" "C"))
                        ("value" . ,val)
                        ("note" . "Demo adat, nem valos idojaras.")))))
      (t (jsonencode (("error" . "Ismeretlen tool")))))))

(defun toolcallroundtrip (userquestion)
  "1) elküldjük a tool definíciót
   2) ha tool_calls érkezik, lokálisan lefuttatjuk és visszaküldjük
   3) végső választ kérünk"
  (let ((tools (list (makeweathertool)))
         (messages (list (msg "system" "Te egy segitokesz asszisztens vagy.")
                         (msg "user" userquestion)))
         (resp1 (xaichatcompletions messages :tools tools))
         (choice1 (first (gethash "choices" resp1)))
         (assistantmsg (gethash "message" choice1))
         (toolcalls (gethash "tool_calls" assistantmsg)))
    (if (and toolcalls (> (length toolcalls) 0))
        (let ((tc (first toolcalls))
               (tcid (gethash "id" tc))
               (fname (gethash "name" (gethash "function" tc)))
               (fargs (gethash "arguments" (gethash "function" tc)))
               (toolresult (applytoollocally fname fargs))
               (messages2 (append messages
                                  (list assistantmsg) ; fontos, hogy az assistent tool_calls is visszakerüljön
                                  (list (("role" . "tool")
                                          ("tool_call_id" . ,tcid)
                                          ("content" . ,toolresult))))))
          (xaichatcompletions messages2))
        ;; ha nincs tool hívás, visszaadjuk az első választ
        resp1)))

;;;;  Demo futás 

(defun demochat ()
  (let ((messages (list
                    (msg "system" "Te egy roviden valaszolo asszisztens vagy.")
                    (msg "user" "Mi a lenyege a Grok 4 Fast modellnek 12 mondatban?")))
         (resp (xaichatcompletions messages :temperature 0.3)))
    resp))

(defun demojsonmode ()
  (let ((messages (list
                    (msg "system" "Csak JSON objektummal valaszolj.")
                    (msg "user" "Adj vissza egy {title, bullets[]} tarolo JSONt a Grok 4 Fast fo elonyeirol.")))
         (resp (xaichatcompletions messages
                                     :responseformat '(("type" . "json_object"))
                                     :temperature 0.2)))
    resp))

(defun demovision ()
  (let ((messages (list
                    (visioncontent
                     "Irj rovid leirast a kep tartalmarol magyarul:"
                     "")))
         (resp (xaichatcompletions messages)))
    resp))

(defun demoembeddings ()
  (xaiembeddings '("Grok 4 Fast integacio CLISPben."
                    "xAI REST API hivasok Repliten.")))

(defun demotoolcalling ()
  (toolcallroundtrip "Milyen az idojaras Budapesten C fokban?"))

(defun printsection (title obj)
  (format t "~&~%==== ~A ====~%~A~%~%" title (pretty obj)))

(defun main ()
  (format t "~&[INFO] xAI Grok 4 Fast demo indul...~%")
  (ensureapikey)

  (let ((resp1 (demochat)))
    (printsection "Chat (egyszeru)" resp1))

  (let ((resp2 (demojsonmode)))
    (printsection "JSON mode (response_format=json_object)" resp2))

  (let ((resp3 (demotoolcalling)))
    (printsection "Tool calling (lokalis vegrehajtas + roundtrip)" resp3))

  (let ((resp4 (demovision)))
    (printsection "Vision (image_url resz)" resp4))

  (let ((resp5 (demoembeddings)))
    (printsection "Embeddings" resp5))

  (format t "~&[KESZ]~%"))

(main)

  (let* ((home (user-homedir-pathname))
         (ql-setup (merge-pathnames "quicklisp/setup.lisp" home)))
    (unless (probe-file ql-setup)
      (let ((ql-bootstrap (merge-pathnames "quicklisp.lisp" home)))
        #+clisp
        (progn
          (ext:run-program "curl" (list "-L" "https://beta.quicklisp.org/quicklisp.lisp" "-o" (namestring ql-bootstrap)) :output t)
          (load ql-bootstrap)
          (funcall (intern "INSTALL" "QUICKLISP") :path (namestring (merge-pathnames "quicklisp/" home)))
          (funcall (intern "ADD-TO-INIT-FILE" "QUICKLISP")))
        #-clisp
        (progn
          (handler-case
              (progn
                (uiop:run-program (list "curl" "-L" "https://beta.quicklisp.org/quicklisp.lisp" "-o" (namestring ql-bootstrap)) :output t)
                (load ql-bootstrap)
                (funcall (intern "INSTALL" "QUICKLISP") :path (namestring (merge-pathnames "quicklisp/" home)))
                (funcall (intern "ADD-TO-INIT-FILE" "QUICKLISP")))
            (error (e)
              (error "Quicklisp telepites sikertelen: ~A" e))))))
    (load ql-setup)))

(ql:quickload '(:drakma :cl+ssl :cl-json :flexi-streams) :silent t)

(defpackage :xai-demo
  (:use :cl)
  (:export :main))
(in-package :xai-demo)

(defun getenv* (name)
  #+clisp (ext:getenv name)
  #-clisp (uiop:getenv name))

(defparameter *xai-api-key* (or (getenv* "XAI_API_KEY") ""))
(defparameter *xai-base-url* "https://api.x.ai/v1")
(defparameter *xai-chat-model* "grok-4-fast")
(defparameter *xai-embedding-model* "grok-embedding-1")

(defun ensure-api-key ()
  (when (or (null *xai-api-key*) (string= *xai-api-key* ""))
    (error "Hianyzik az XAI_API_KEY kornyezeti valtozo. A Replit Secrets-ben add hozza.")))

(defun json-encode (obj)
  (cl-json:encode-json-to-string obj))

(defun json-decode (str)
  (let ((cl-json:*json-object-type* 'hash-table)
        (cl-json:*json-array-type* 'list))
    (cl-json:decode-json-from-string str)))

(defun http-json (method path payload)
  (ensure-api-key)
  (let* ((url (concatenate 'string *xai-base-url* path))
         (body (and payload (json-encode payload)))
         (headers `(("Authorization" . ,(concatenate 'string "Bearer " *xai-api-key*))
                    ("Content-Type" . "application/json")
                    ("Accept" . "application/json"))))
    (multiple-value-bind (resp-body status resp-headers)
        (drakma:http-request url
                             :method method
                             :content body
                             :additional-headers headers
                             :want-stream nil
                             :force-binary nil
                             :redirect t
                             :connection-timeout 30
                             :read-timeout 120
                             :external-format :utf-8)
      (when (or (null resp-body) (not (<= 200 status 299)))
        (ignore-errors
          (let ((err (json-decode (or resp-body ""))))
            (let ((msg (or (and (hash-table-p err) (gethash "error" err)) err)))
              (when msg
                (error "HTTP hiba ~A: ~A" status (json-encode msg))))))
        (error "HTTP hiba ~A: ~A" status (or resp-body "")))
      (json-decode resp-body))))

(defun pretty (x)
  (cl-json:encode-json-to-string x :escape-slash nil :indent t))

(defun xai-chat-completions (messages &key (model *xai-chat-model*) tools response-format temperature)
  (let ((payload (let ((base `(("model" . ,model)
                               ("messages" . ,messages))))
                   (when tools
                     (setf base (append base `(("tools" . ,tools)))))
                   (when response-format
                     (setf base (append base `(("response_format" . ,response-format)))))
                   (when temperature
                     (setf base (append base `(("temperature" . ,temperature)))))
                   base)))
    (http-json :post "/chat/completions" payload)))

(defun xai-embeddings (inputs &key (model *xai-embedding-model*))
  (http-json :post "/embeddings"
             `(("model" . ,model)
               ("input" . ,(if (listp inputs) inputs (list inputs))))))

(defun msg (role content)
  `(("role" . ,role) ("content" . ,content)))

(defun vision-content (text image-url)
  `(("role" . "user")
    ("content" .
      ,(list
         `(("type" . "text") ("text" . ,text))
         `(("type" . "image_url") ("image_url" . (("url" . ,image-url)))))))))

(defun make-weather-tool ()
  `(("type" . "function")
    ("function" .
      (("name" . "get_weather")
       ("description" . "Egyszeru idojaras-kerdezo demo; varos/orszag alapjan ad vissza homersekletet (fiktiv).")
       ("parameters" .
         (("type" . "object")
          ("properties" .
            (("location" . (("type" . "string")
                            ("description" . "Varos vagy orszag neve.")))
             ("unit" . (("type" . "string")
                        ("enum" . ("C" "F"))
                        ("description" . "Homerseklet egysege.")))))
          ("required" . ("location"))))))))

(defun apply-tool-locally (name args-json)
  (let* ((args (json-decode args-json))
         (get (lambda (k) (and (hash-table-p args) (gethash k args))))
         (unit (or (funcall get "unit") "C")))
    (cond
      ((string= name "get_weather")
       (let* ((loc (or (funcall get "location") "Ismeretlen"))
              (temp-c 21.5)
              (val (if (string= unit "F")
                       (+ (* temp-c 9/5) 32)
                       temp-c)))
         (json-encode `(("location" . ,loc)
                        ("temperature" . ,(if (string= unit "F") "F" "C"))
                        ("value" . ,val)
                        ("note" . "Demo adat, nem valos idojaras.")))))
      (t (json-encode `(("error" . "Ismeretlen tool")))))))

(defun tool-call-roundtrip (user-question)
  (let* ((tools (list (make-weather-tool)))
         (messages (list (msg "system" "Te egy segitokesz asszisztens vagy.")
                         (msg "user" user-question)))
         (resp1 (xai-chat-completions messages :tools tools))
         (choice1 (first (gethash "choices" resp1)))
         (assistant-msg (and choice1 (gethash "message" choice1)))
         (tool-calls (and assistant-msg (gethash "tool_calls" assistant-msg))))
    (if (and tool-calls (listp tool-calls) (> (length tool-calls) 0))
        (let* ((tc (first tool-calls))
               (tc-id (gethash "id" tc))
               (fname (gethash "name" (gethash "function" tc)))
               (fargs (gethash "arguments" (gethash "function" tc)))
               (tool-result (apply-tool-locally fname fargs))
               (messages2 (append messages
                                  (list assistant-msg)
                                  (list `(("role" . "tool")
                                          ("tool_call_id" . ,tc-id)
                                          ("content" . ,tool-result))))))
          (xai-chat-completions messages2))
        resp1)))
